name: xThemeSong
overview: Download theme songs from YouTube or upload custom MP3s for your media library
description: A plugin that automatically downloads theme songs from YouTube by user provided video ID/URL or allows uploading custom MP3 files. Looks theme songs up automatically in ThemerrDB, falling back to the title's soundtrack listing. Features complete Web UI with drag-and-drop upload, audio player, export/import, role-based permissions, per-user preferences, and media library overview.
changelog: v1.3.0: Automatic theme lookup - ThemerrDB first, then the IMDb soundtrack listing searched on YouTube. OMDb resolves missing IMDb IDs. All outbound requests send full browser headers, with a headless-browser fallback for IMDb's bot check, request throttling and backoff on failed lookups.
